config.description: VibeVO Public API key (vibevo_live_...). Optional for anonymous public creator catalog/page reads; required for other tools.

config.label: Base URL of the VibeVO API
config.description: Base URL of the VibeVO API. Optional; defaults to https://api.vibevo.io.

config.label: Optional positive account ID for authenticated placement participant requests, including private deliverable downloads
config.description: Optional positive account ID for authenticated placement participant requests, including private deliverable downloads. Omit to use the API-key owner's account; it is not sent to anonymous reads, creator profile/channel operations, or signed upload PUTs.
